dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

exports.description: Archived apps whose disk image gets a Sparkle feed

archive.description: The .xcarchive whose app states its Sparkle feed in SUFeedURL

folder.description: Folder holding the disk image of that app

title: Release publish
description: Signs a Sparkle feed for each disk image the target's dependency targets wrote with generate_appcast under SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY, pointing at the image's asset on the GitHub release of the project's version, and uploads it to the R2 bucket SPARKLE_FEED_BUCKET names at the path of the app's SUFeedURL through cf r2 objects put; runs through nx release publish
